description: Signing census exceptions (Phase 23 plan 23-17, CHAR-04, D-NONCE-AUTHORITY-ALL). Read by scripts/check-signing-census.ts (npm run check:census). floor: the minimum number of transaction-signing sites in src/ and scripts/; lower it only in a commit whose message names the finding (AUD-...) whose fix removed the site (AC-34, checked by --check-floor-history). unlocked: the known transaction-signing sites outside withNonceLock, one row per file|enclosing|call key with a count; each row names its finding and the operator decision records that cover it (AC-53); a fixed or removed site fails the gate until its row is lowered or removed (AC-35). excluded: sites the census counts but an auditor proved are not signing (view calls whose ABI the type analysis cannot read), each citing the manual inventory entry that excludes it. dead: signing sites in a function the census proves unreachable (module-level, not exported, zero references), each citing a finding whose recommendation deletes the function; a dead site is neither locked nor unlocked but counts toward the floor, and the row fails the gate when the function gains a caller or an export (dead-reachable) or disappears (stale-dead). Entries are sorted by key.

The dead tokenSafety.simulateSell sends a real approve outside withNonceLock (operator ruling keep-s1). Phase 24 removes it; then this row must come off the list and the floor drop by one (24 to 23 at the Phase 23 review-fix count) in a commit naming AUD-BUY-007.

dead.reason: maybeApproveForChain is not exported and has no reference anywhere in the program (the census proves both), so its approve never runs. AUD-BUY-007 recommends deleting it. Its lock key ctx.wallet.address cannot be tied to the tokenContract runner because nothing calls it (WR-24).
dead.note: Operator ruling on the Phase 23 WR-24 escalation, 2026-11-12. When Phase 24 (or Phase 29) deletes the function, remove this row (stale-dead) and lower the floor by one in that commit, naming AUD-BUY-007.

excluded.reason: getPair is a view function (the Uniswap V2 factory pair getter): an eth_call, no transaction, no nonce. The census cannot read the artifact ABI, so it counts the call.

allowance is a view function in every ERC-20 ABI in the program, and maybeApproveForChain has no caller, so this line never runs. The census cannot trace the tokenContract parameter, so it counts the call with lock status unknown.
